title: Relative pseudo-coherence of complexes is invariant under pushforward along finite morphisms
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For pi : X -> Y finite between schemes locally of finite type over S and E in D_QCoh(O_X), the lemma says E is m-pseudo-coherent relative to S if and only if Rpi_* E is. The retained proof is written as an explicit translation protocol rather than a pointer: the schemes-side pseudo-coherence dictionary (chapter lemma relative-pseudo-coherence-characterize, already collected) reduces the statement to the affine algebra theorem More on Algebra, lemma finite-extension-pseudo-coherent (pseudo-coherence of a complex over R equals that over a finite extension A); the author additionally verifies the side condition that Rpi_* preserves quasi-coherence (Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma quasi-coherence-direct-image) so both sides are stated in D_QCoh. Retained author proof at lines 17003-17013.
